parameters.query: SELECT a.id, a.appointment_ref, a.customer_id, a.service_id, a.status, a.appointment_start, a.appointment_end, c.email, c.full_name, sc.duration_minutes FROM appointments a JOIN customers c ON c.id = a.customer_id JOIN service_catalog sc ON sc.id = a.service_id WHERE a.appointment_ref = {{ $json.appointment_ref }} AND c.email = {{ $json.customer_email }} LIMIT 1;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, message: 'The appointment cannot be rescheduled in its current state.', status: 'invalid_reschedule_request' } }}

parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM appointments a WHERE a.status IN ('pending','confirmed','reschedule_requested') AND a.id <> {{ $json.id }} AND a.appointment_start < DATE_ADD({{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, INTERVAL {{ $json.duration_minutes }} MINUTE) AND a.appointment_end > {{ $json.new_appointment_start }} ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS new_slot_available;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, message: 'The requested new time is unavailable. Your existing appointment remains unchanged.', status: 'slot_unavailable' } }}

parameters.query: START TRANSACTION; SELECT id FROM appointments WHERE id = {{ $json.id }} FOR UPDATE; INSERT INTO appointment_slots (appointment_id, slot_start, slot_end, status, reserved_at) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, {{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, DATE_ADD({{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, INTERVAL {{ $json.duration_minutes }} MINUTE), 'reserved', NOW()); UPDATE appointments SET appointment_start = {{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, appointment_end = DATE_ADD({{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, INTERVAL {{ $json.duration_minutes }} MINUTE), status = 'reschedule_requested', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}; COMMIT;

UPDATE appointments SET appointment_start = {{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, appointment_end = DATE_ADD({{ $json.new_appointment_start }}, INTERVAL {{ $json.duration_minutes }} MINUTE), status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Reschedule request for appointment ' + $json.appointment_ref }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Hi ' + $json.full_name + ',

Your reschedule request for appointment ' + $json.appointment_ref + ' has been received and is being reviewed.
Requested new date/time: ' + $json.new_appointment_start + '

We will confirm or update you once the schedule is finalized.' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Appointment reschedule request ' + $json.appointment_ref }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Customer requested a reschedule.
Reference: ' + $json.appointment_ref + '
Customer: ' + $json.full_name + '
Email: ' + $json.email + '
Current time: ' + $json.appointment_start + '
New time: ' + $json.new_appointment_start + '
Status: reschedule_requested' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: 'Your request to reschedule has been received and is pending review.', appointment_reference: $json.appointment_ref, status: 'reschedule_requested' } }}
